results.description:
Used by over 160,000 pilots worldwide, LogTen Pilot Logbook by Pilotbase is the most trusted digital logbook in aviation, designed to support pilots throughout their whole aviation career. Whether you're logging your first solo or preparing for your next type rating, LogTen offers powerful tools to keep you current, compliant, and ready for every opportunity.

▶ Try before you buy – Your first 50 hours of total flight time are on us. ◀
▶ Need flight data imported from your old logbook? We’ll do it for you just email us at imports@logten.com! ◀

▶ What Pilots Say ◀
“Excellent program. Smart and simple to understand. I can log every aspect of my flight with a few taps. Love that it keeps track of currency, and expiring certificates like medical. Customer support is amazing. This App is a must have for all pilots.”

▶ LOG & PROTECT ◀
• Lightning fast data entry on Watch, iPhone and iPad (also available on your Mac with Pro subscription!)
• Automated and totally customizable for the type of flying you do
• Schedule import for over 100 airlines with LogTen Pro
• All your devices, always in sync
• Protects your logbook with automatic and manual backups. You can even name your backups for easy organization.

▶ ANALYZE & REPORT ◀
• One tap access to key analytics pilots need for each aircraft you fly - multi-engine, turbine, PIC, SIC, total instrument etc.
• Powerful, industry leading Smart Group technology so you can track virtually any aspect of your time and get the answers you need instantly - no calculator needed
• Over 100 built-in reports including experience reports, logbook formats from around the world, 8710 and pilot job applications including automated digital signature on every page!

▶ PLAN & TRACK ◀
• Use LogTen Pro for Mac to import your flight schedule, or one of our third party partners with LogTen Basic (iOS Only)
• Track your goals with custom filters - for example progress towards achieving your ATPL, or how much XC Night you have
• Track your currencies, flight limits, flight duty limits, and rest
• Industry first Dynamic Time Loupe™ enables you to quickly identify potential future issues with rest, duty or flight duty period limits before they happen, including complex rest and duty regulations such as FAR117 and EASA regulations

▶ CAREER ACCESS ◀
• Put your job search on autopilot and land the job faster with personalized career matching inside LogTen
• Personalized job matching based on your actual hours, ratings, and flight experience
• Tons of flight hour-building opportunities to help you reach your next minimums faster
• All major pilot job types in one place — 121, 135, 91, corporate, and cadet programs 
• Find the right job faster with career search built directly into your LogTen logbookTurn your logbook into a career advancement tool, not just a record of flights



Subscription Information:

As part of our goal to help more pilots succeed, we offer the LogTen service completely free until you have logged more than 50 hours of total time! And with or without a subscription, you always get updates, and you always get full access to your data, where you can view, edit, generate reports, export, and print.

Pricing may vary by location (see pricing under Top in App Purchases, or right in the App in the Store section of Settings). Your subscription will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account and will automatically renew 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period, unless auto-renew is disabled beforehand. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be disabled by going to your iTunes account settings after purchase. A subscription cannot be cancelled during the active subscription period.
